title: Discovering Translation-Worthy Languages with E-Values
abstract: arXiv:2609.06593v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Choosing when to translate multilingual documents is a central routing problem in text classification: translation can improve predictions for some languages while degrading others or adding unnecessary computation. Uniform translation and heuristic language tiers do not provide statistically controlled route selection. We introduce a language-level router based on paired e-processes that continuously compares direct and translation-assisted classification before freezing a routing policy. A familywise-controlled threshold of 280 bounds the probability of any false route across 14 eligible languages per dataset by 0.05. On SIB-200 and MASSIVE, the router selects translation for 4 of 15 languages and 14 of 15 locales, improving held-out accuracy over direct classification by 8.14 and 16.70 percentage points, respectively. All 28 decisions remain stable across 50 outcome-independent orderings and relative to the per-group threshold. Our

translated_title: 用E值发现值得翻译的语言
translated_abstract: 在多语言文档的文本分类中，选择何时进行翻译是一个核心的路由问题：翻译可以提升某些语言的预测效果，但也可能损害其他语言的性能或增加不必要的计算开销。统一翻译策略和启发式语言分层方法都无法提供具有统计控制的路由选择。我们提出了一种基于配对e过程的语言级路由器，它在最终确定路由策略之前，持续比较直接分类与翻译辅助分类的效果。一个族错误率受控的阈值280将每个数据集中14种合格语言出现任何错误路由的概率限制在0.05以内。在SIB-200和MASSIVE数据集上，该路由器分别为15种语言中的4种和15个语言环境中的14个选择了翻译策略，相比直接分类分别将留出集准确率提升了8.14和16.70个百分点。所有28个路由决策在50种与结果无关的排列顺序下，以及相对于各组阈值的变化，均保持稳定。
tldr: 提出一种基于配对e过程、具有族错误率统计控制的语言级路由器，可自动判断哪些语言值得采用翻译辅助分类，在SIB-200和MASSIVE数据集上分别将准确率提升8.14和16.70个百分点。
en_tdlr: A language-level router based on paired e-processes with familywise error control automatically determines which languages benefit from translation, improving accuracy by 8.14 and 16.70 percentage points on SIB-200 and MASSIVE respectively.
